findings.title: Broken relative reference
findings.message: The manifest references `references/playbook.md`, but the file was not found.
findings.rationale: Broken references can make a skill behave differently than documented or fail at runtime.
findings.remediation: Create the referenced file, update the link, or remove the stale reference.
findings.suppression: Suppress `SKILL010` only with a documented reason in the project audit config.

findings.title: Missing skill description
findings.message: The skill manifest does not declare a description.
findings.rationale: Reviewers and host profiles need a concise behavior statement for the skill.
findings.remediation: Add a non-empty `description` field to frontmatter or an opening paragraph.
findings.suppression: Suppress `SKILL002` only with a documented reason in the project audit config.

findings.title: Duplicate skill name
findings.message: The skill name `corpus-host-duplicate` is also declared by other manifest path(s): `.claude/skills/duplicate-b/SKILL.md`.
findings.rationale: Duplicate names make inventory, policy, host routing, and review ambiguous.
findings.remediation: Rename packages so every scanned skill has a unique stable name.
findings.suppression: Suppress `SKILL030` only with a documented reason in the project audit config.
